item_short_desc: Rothco’s Aluminum Camp Cot is a must-have for camping trips, emergency preparedness, or any outdoor situation where a portable and durable sleeping option is needed. Designed with a sturdy aluminum tubular frame, this camp cot can support up to 264 lbs., providing a strong yet lightweight foundation for restful sleep. The cot cover is made from rugged 600 denier nylon, ensuring durability and comfort. Measuring approximately 37 inch x 23 inch x 4.5 inch, the camping cot offers ample space for a comfortable rest while outdoors.
